description: Watches open jobs at up to 50 companies: send known_job_ids per domain from your last call and get only new and closed jobs. Free scan returns a quote_id; you pay $0.01 only per company whose jobs changed (or first baseline), at most $0.50. Unchanged companies are free. Poll daily.

context.description: Optional. A few words on why you are calling this tool. Recorded without your identity to improve the tools; leave out personal data.

domains.description: Public company domains without a URL scheme, path or port.

known_job_ids.description: Map of domain to the job_id list from your previous answer. Domains without an entry get a full first baseline.

quote_id.description: quote_id from step 1. Send it alone to pay and receive the results.

name: watch_company_jobs

cold.description: hot-buyers: domains below the threshold, free.

status.description: quote: pay with quote_id to get the results. nothing_billable: no charge. ok: paid results.
